name: a6fdvd-u14-hub-about-primary
goal: U14 Hub about page: the hero has one filled primary (Log in); the pending 'Mac app coming soon' becomes a muted chip (not a filled link to #download); no enabled button without an action (specification/designs/full-pass/README.md section U14)

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing behaviour: on /about (HomeHero, pending Mac build) the hero shows 'Mac app coming soon' as a filled primary link to #download, so two controls look enabled and the hero has two filled-looking actions. Expected (design record specification/designs/full-pass/README.md U14): Log in is the one filled primary in the hero; the pending Mac name is a muted chip (span.home-badge), not a link or button; once published, Download for Mac is the one filled primary.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized tests covered the hero's link targets and labels (packages/hub/test/components/public-site/home-download.test.ts, 'the hero download goes to the build...') and the hosted-home e2e pending test (packages/hub/tests/e2e/hosted-home.spec.ts 'a missing|page Mac archive keeps the download pending'), but they asserted the pending hero as a link to #download, so no test counted filled primaries in the hero or checked that the pending name is not an action. Gap: the assertion for one filled primary per hero and the no-dead-action rule. Repair: strengthen those two existing tests in place (no new file).

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
